channel.title: Publications on CEDIS
channel.description: Software registrations and technological assets from CEDIS.

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026003514-7, for an intelligent chatbot based on language models that supports the elicitation, organization, and formalization of requirements, with automated generation of user stories. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026003515-5, for a Telegram-based virtual assistant that uses AI with a RAG approach to centralize and answer administrative and academic questions from FCTE/UnB students. Official INPI title: @FCTEBot. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026000889-1, with the certificate issued on February 18, 2026.

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026005122-3, for a gamified mobile application for children ages 4 to 10, aligned with the Eu Me Protejo project’s booklets, supporting self-protection and the prevention of child sexual abuse. Official INPI title: EuMeProtejo. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026003650-0, for a system that uses machine learning and morphokinetic data for the non-invasive prediction of embryonic euploidy, supporting clinical decision-making in assisted reproduction. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026005120-7, for a gamified offline mobile application based on the “Pró-vida e Eu Me Protejo” project’s Good Practices Manual, supporting parents, guardians, and educators in preventing childhood violence. Official INPI title: “Gamified mobile application for the prevention of childhood violence, aimed at parents and educators”. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).
